F1.title: TorchScript archive: treat as executable code
F1.detail: This zip is a TorchScript program (torch.jit.save, or the PyTorch mobile lite-interpreter writer). Its 4 TorchScript class name(s) (__torch__.Net, __torch__.torch.nn.modules.batchnorm.BatchNorm1d, __torch__.torch.nn.modules.linear.Linear and 1 more) are built by torch.jit.load from the code stored in the archive, not imported from Python. PyTorch's security policy (SECURITY.md) says to treat TorchScript models like locally executable code from an unknown source: load it only from a provider you trust. Other imports in the archive are reported by their usual rules.
